attributes.name: Blasting Pistol +2
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Dexterity or Ranged skill + 1d6+2; you may additionally bury this card to add another 4d4 and the Force trait. If you did not bury this card, roll 1d6, or 1d12 if proficient with weapons; on a 1, shuffle this card into your deck.

If proficient with weapons, discard this card to add 2d4 and the Force trait to a combat check by a character at your location.
